description: Make a new dance of your resident's own from moves: hop, twirl, sway, wave, bow, shimmy, wiggle, pose, nap and about thirty more. A move can have a manner (twirl slowly), come more than once (hop 2, or hop twice), or be a short line acted out. Up to 24 moves. Then it's known by its name: dance does it and film_dance films it. Anyone who visits can see it danced. Each name is new: a name already in use is refused, and nothing is replaced. If you don't know the moves, call check (what: moves) first: it lists every one.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

moves.description: The moves in order, like ["sway", "twirl slowly", "hop 2", "bow"].

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

title.description: Optional: a title, like Sunday Morning.

name: make_dance
title: Make a dance
